_readme: A blueprint: everything the platform needs to know about one design, apart from how it looks. See platform/README.md.

labels.company.name: Business name
labels.services[].name: Service name
labels.testimonials[].author: Customer name
labels.gallery[].alt: Describe the photo (for blind visitors and Google)

help.company.description: Two or three sentences: what you do, who for, and why people pick you.
help.services: Add each job you want customers to find, e.g. 'Leak repair' or 'Boiler installation'.

ai.company.description: Write a warm, plain-English description of {company.name}, a {company.category_label} serving {company.service_areas}. 2-3 sentences.
ai.services: Suggest 4 common services for a {company.category_label}, each with a one-sentence description.
ai.gallery[].alt: Describe this photo of a {company.category_label} project in under 15 words.
